lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
Is dasht mein ek shehar tha, woh kya hua, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this mad heart of mine gone dark, and what became of the city that once stood in this desert, my wandering?

lines: Kal shab mujhe be-shakl si aawaz ne chaunka diya.
Maine kaha, tu kaun hai, us ne kaha, aawargi.
couplets.en: Last night a disembodied voice startled me, and when I asked who it was, it called itself wandering.

lines: Logo, bhala us shehar mein kaise jiyenge hum?
Jahan ho jurm tanha sochna, lekin saza aawargi.
couplets.en: How are we to live in a city where thinking alone is a crime and wandering is the sentence?

lines: Ek ajnabi jhonke ne jab poochha mere gham ka sabab.
Sehra ki bheegi ret par maine likha, aawargi.
couplets.en: When a passing gust asked why I grieved, I wrote wandering in the damp desert sand.

lines: Kal raat tanha chaand ko dekha tha maine khwaab mein.
couplets.en: Last night I saw the lonely moon in a dream.
